text_blocks.snippet: For chronic kidney disease (CKD) Stage 3, medications focus on managing symptoms, slowing disease progression, and addressing related health issues like high blood pressure and diabetes. Commonly prescribed medications include ACE inhibitors/ARBs, SGLT2 inhibitors, and medications to manage blood pressure, blood sugar, and cholesterol, as well as supplements for bone health.
